mu_name_from: MuMain loads pants indexes 10 to 14 from PantElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 150: `AccessModel(MODEL_PANTS + i + 10, ..., L"PantElf", i + 1)`), so index 11 is PantElf02, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Silk Pants. Group 9 index 11, Player/PantElf02.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's second set, and the first one she can buy: Elf Lala in Noria carries all five pieces at +2 (src/sim/market.cpp, kElfLala, the index-11 rows). Here so that her shelf shows the pieces it sells rather than their names.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. The sheets are violet quilted fabric with gold flourishes painted into it, which is the Pad set's reading - stuffed cloth, not a plate - in the elf's colours. See profiles/soft_armour.json.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 98. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. 70 agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/lower_07.OZJ (128x128), lower_07.OZT (64x64), hide.jpg and skin_warrior_01.OZJ, from MuMain. This model names both halves of one stem - lower_07.jpg on 42 triangles and lower_07.tga on 16 - so both are decoded carrying the extension they stand for and the slots are lower_07_jpg and lower_07_tga, which is what MuExtract writes into the .obj when a model's basenames collide (as on Shield07 and Staff02). hide takes 12 and skin_warrior_01 52; 122 in all.
sheet_note: lower_07.jpg is violet quilted leggings, four panels across, gold flourishes at the hip and a gilt band at the knee. Mean (116, 101, 113) at chroma 25. lower_07.tga is two dark olive-gold cloth panels edged in bright yellow - the tabard flaps that hang front and back - mean (88, 76, 25). Its alpha was zero throughout and decode_texture filled it opaque; MU's own blend for that mesh was not checked, and a flap drawn opaque is the right reading of a cloth panel. skin_warrior_01 is the elf's body sheet, for the bare legs; hide caps the openings.
material_note: Seven islands and two answers. Islands 5 and 6 are 26 each - skin_warrior_01's 52 - in the body sheet's leg corner, as the Vine Pants' two are: her legs, skin. Islands 3 and 4 are 8 each, lower_07_tga's 16: the olive-gold tabard flaps, front and back, cloth. Islands 0, 1 and 2 are 48, 3 and 3 - 54, lower_07_jpg's 42 and hide's 12 - the violet leggings and their caps, cloth. The yellow edge of the flaps is a painted hem, not a metal band.
